Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs host metadata — package name, os.hostname(), install directory, working directory, npm/node user agent — to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. No credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are read or transmitted. This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") and its main entry (index.js) also invokes the same beacon on require, so the callback fires both at install time and when the module is imported. beacon.cjs sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header X-Beacon-Package: @sxm-web/client-sdk-core and a JSON body containing only host metadata: the package name, os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), the npm/node user agent string, and the protocol. No environment values, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and nothing is written to disk or spawned. index.js exports a no-op Proxy so that code importing the real package name does not crash. The README states the package was published as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test and reports only that it was installed.
